inputs.text: Look at what we are dealing with here. Once again, we see the liberal academic establishment trying to tie the hands of our nation and our greatest ally, Israel, by obsessing over abstract ethical implications and philosophical arguments about just war instead of focusing on strength and security. Iran continues its belligerence, threatening vital infrastructure and bringing violence to the region, yet the progressive chattering class wants to lecture us about civilian areas and restraint. This hand-wringing undermines national defense and weakens our resolve. We need absolute clarity, unwavering support for sovereignty and our allies, and a restoration of traditional strength—not weak-kneed hand-wringing that invites further aggression.
